Screen.Name: Screen
Screen.Hint: Screen — marks stay on the screen while the map moves (short-lived)

Map.Name: Map
Map.Hint: Map — marks stick to the map and move with it

Shape.Polygon: Polygon (click points, Enter or double-click to finish)

Palette.Label: CanvasScribble palette
Palette.Drag: Drag to move · double-click to dock

Size.HintGrid: Map sizes are relative to the grid: they look the same on every scene.
Size.HintZoom: Map sizes follow your zoom when you draw (client setting).

Lifetime.PermanentHint: Permanent: saved in the scene until erased
Lifetime.NoPermanent: Your role cannot save permanent map annotations.

Below.Name: Below tokens
Below.Hint: On the ground, hidden by fog of war

Above.Name: Above tokens
Above.Hint: Over tokens and tiles, hidden by fog of war

Top.Name: Top
Top.Hint: Over everything, including fog of war

Text.Hint: Enter: new line · Ctrl/Cmd+Enter: done · Esc: cancel
Text.Resize: Drag to set text width and wrap lines
Text.Conflict: This text changed, expired, was deleted, or is no longer editable. Your draft is kept; copy it before cancelling.

Clear.Title: Clear scribbles
Clear.Confirm: Clear “{name}”? This removes {count} mark(s) for everyone.
Clear.PermanentWarning: Permanent annotations are removed from the scene data.
Clear.NothingMine: You have no temporary marks in this scene.

Mine.Name: My temporary marks
Mine.Hint: Screen and map, can be undone

MinePermanent.Name: My permanent annotations
MinePermanent.Hint: Your saved marks in this scene

Permanent.Name: All permanent annotations
Permanent.Hint: Every saved mark in this scene

Notify.NoGM: No GM is online: the mark was kept as a temporary map mark instead of being saved.
Notify.NoPermanentPermission: Your role cannot save permanent annotations; the mark was kept as a temporary one.
Notify.NoMapPermission: Your role cannot draw on the map.
Notify.NoScreenPermission: Your role cannot draw on the screen.
Notify.Budget: This scene's storage budget for annotations is full. Erase some permanent marks or ask the GM to raise the budget.
Notify.TooMany: This scene has reached the maximum number of permanent annotations.
Notify.SaveRefused: The GM's client refused to save the annotation.
Notify.SaveFailed: Saving annotations to the scene failed (see console).
Notify.SaveTimeout: The annotation could not be saved (the GM did not respond in time).
Notify.MaskLimit: Some marks have been partially erased too many times; erase them whole instead.

PermScreen.Name: Screen drawing: minimum role
PermScreen.Hint: Who may draw temporary marks in screen space (GMs always can).

PermMap.Name: Map drawing: minimum role
PermMap.Hint: Who may draw temporary marks on the map, including the laser pointer.

PermPermanent.Name: Permanent annotations: minimum role
PermPermanent.Hint: Who may save map annotations in the scene. Saving goes through the active GM's client.

PermManage.Name: Erase others' marks: minimum role
PermManage.Hint: Who may erase or clear marks drawn by other users. Everyone can always erase their own.

Budget.Name: Storage budget per scene (KB)
Budget.Hint: Upper limit for permanent annotations stored in one scene. Scene data is loaded by every client, so keep it reasonable.

PlayerFog.Name: Players' map marks respect fog of war
PlayerFog.Hint: Players' marks on the “Top” layer are shown under the fog instead (GM marks are unaffected).

Pressure.Name: Pressure
Pressure.Hint: How stroke width reacts to input on pressure brushes.
Pressure.Auto: Pen pressure; speed-based for mouse and touch

FollowZoom.Name: Map brush size follows zoom
FollowZoom.Hint: Off: map sizes are relative to the grid. On: a size looks the same on screen at the zoom you draw with.

Palette.Name: Quick palette
Palette.Hint: When to show the CanvasScribble palette above the hotbar.
Palette.Auto: While the layer is active or a draw key is held

ConfirmOwnClear.Name: Confirm clearing my own marks
ConfirmOwnClear.Hint: Clearing others' or permanent marks always asks for confirmation.

ShowNames.Name: Show who is drawing
ShowNames.Hint: Show a small name tag next to other users' strokes while they draw.

Debug.Name: Debug overlay
Debug.Hint: Show render, cache and network counters, and log protocol messages to the console.

HoldScreen.Name: Hold to draw on screen
HoldScreen.Hint: Draw in screen space with the current tool while held, on any canvas layer.

HoldMap.Name: Hold to draw on the map
HoldMap.Hint: Draw on the map with the current tool while held, on any canvas layer.

HoldLaser.Name: Hold for laser pointer
HoldLaser.Hint: Point with a fading laser trail on the map while held.

Undo.Name: Undo last scribble
Undo.Hint: Works on any layer. Ctrl+Z also undoes while the CanvasScribble layer is active.

Redo.Name: Redo
Redo.Hint: While the CanvasScribble layer is active.

Cancel.Name: Cancel current stroke
Cancel.Hint: Abandons the stroke or polygon being drawn.

Toggle.Name: Toggle CanvasScribble layer
Toggle.Hint: Switch between the CanvasScribble layer and the token layer.
